text: If it touches you... you die.
SCP-049. The Plague Doctor. And it thinks I'm sick.
It says it can smell the Pestilence on me.
One touch, and everything stops. Your heart. Your breath.
Then it opens its black bag... and starts the surgery.
It calls them cured. And they get back up.
Tonight, the power went out. Its cell door is open.
And somewhere in the dark, it whispers... I can smell it on you.
